notes.title: New additional update
notes.content:
hello.
Jipang2Games.

Very late.

I'm sorry.
The release date was later than expected, and the content update required adjustments.

As mentioned earlier, by adding content, puzzles and direction were added.

The front part is the same, but the back part is added, so I think existing users will be able to connect the contents if they continue comfortably.

We also fixed many other bugs that existed.
In addition to optimization, it runs well on a much lower spec computer.



We will come back with preparations for the next new work in the future.

Thank you for always.

notes.title: Improve water quality and optimize resources, fix bugs [2.1 Update]
notes.content:
Hello, we're Jipang2Games.

First of all, thank you for purchasing and playing the game. Thank you for your interest during the discount period.

We checked the feedback and video and modified the graphics-related bugs. We also improved and eliminated minor parts so that there is no problem with the gameplay.

We made the dark part in the beginning of the game brighter.

We reduced game capacity by optimizing resources.

You can now adjust the resolution during the game. We recommend lowering the resolution if there is a lot of lag in the gameplay. We are trying to secure the frame even with low specifications.

For the next additional content, we have improved the quality of water. We expressed water more realistically and increased intuition.

We will continue to improve the game so that you can enjoy it more.

Thank you again.
